name: QiYi Cross Cube 3x3 (Magnetic)
description: The QiYi Cross Cube 3x3 (Magnetic) is a children's speed cube from QiYi's magnetic kids' series, built around a simplified cross motif that gives new solvers a clear pattern to follow across the faces. Magnetic positioning keeps turns stable, and the full-bright, frosted stickerless build is made to be easy on little hands and easy on the eyes.
features: Clear cross pattern: The cross motif across the faces gives new solvers an easy visual cue to track their turns and stay oriented.
Easy for little hands: At 55.5 mm it's sized and tuned for smaller hands to control comfortably.
Magnetic positioning: Magnets assist alignment for stable rotation without the looseness common on entry-level children's cubes.
Frosted surface: The matte finish is scratch-resistant, anti-reflective, and fingerprint-proof, keeping the focus on the solve.
Full-bright color scheme: Bold, clearly distinct colors make it easy for children to tell faces apart while playing.
Stickerless build: Molded colors mean nothing to peel or wear off over time.
